info.title: IntentControlPlaneService
info.description: Administrative API for Intent Router provisioning and lifecycle.

get.description: Lists the models a Router can be configured with, from deployment configuration. The embedding items are the only valid values of vectorSpace: creating a Router with any other is refused with 400. Empty when none are configured, which offers every vector space (development only).

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: What a model is used for. A product serves only the purposes it supports.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size of a list. Defaults to 50 where a service does not say otherwise.

schema.description: Page size of a list. Defaults to 50 where a service does not say otherwise.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque position in a list, returned as `nextCursor` and passed back as `cursor`.

schema.description: Opaque position in a list, returned as `nextCursor` and passed back as `cursor`.

get.description: Lists the tenant's Routers, oldest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size of a list. Defaults to 50 where a service does not say otherwise.

post.description: Creates and provisions one Router and returns it with 201, a Location header and, while it is PROVISIONING, Retry-After. A deployment-configured per-tenant limit applies; the default is 128. An optional Idempotency-Key (<client-id>:<sha256 of the canonical body>) makes a retry return the first response with Idempotent-Replayed: true; keys are kept for 24 hours.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. <client-id>:<hex SHA-256 of the request body with object keys sorted and no extra whitespace>.

schema.description: Optional. <client-id>:<hex SHA-256 of the request body with object keys sorted and no extra whitespace>.

delete.description: Starts deleting a Router and its data: 202 with the Router in the DELETING state, finished asynchronously by the data plane. Deleting a Router that is already gone succeeds with 204 (documented through the OpenAPI overlay).

204.description: DeleteRouter 204 response: the Router is already gone

patch.description: Updates mutable Router settings as a merge patch: an omitted member is unchanged. A null description clears it and a null minScore resets it to the default. The embedding is create-only.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The Router's ETag (its revision, quoted). Same meaning as expectedRevision; if both are sent they must agree.

schema.description: The Router's ETag (its revision, quoted). Same meaning as expectedRevision; if both are sent they must agree.
